services.name: Fishing Trips
services.desc: Blue Water Connection offers one of the premier bottom fishing experiences in the Gulf of Mexico, led by some of the most skilled and accomplished captains in the region. Our team knows where to go and what it takes to consistently produce outstanding catches of red snapper, triggerfish, vermillion snapper, grouper, and powerful amberjack. With our fleet of top-tier, tournament-class vessels and the best equipment in the industry, we are able to put clients on productive bottom fishing grounds and deliver the kind of action and fish counts that make for truly unforgettable trips. We take tremendous pride not only in producing exceptional fishing, but in creating a welcoming, family-friendly

blurb: Blue Water Connection offers deep sea and offshore fishing charters targeting species like Snapper, Grouper, Amberjack, Marlin, Wahoo, King Mackerel, and Mahi-Mahi. They operate three boats accommodating from small groups up to 19 guests, departing from Captain Anderson’s Marina. Trips range from nearshore to overnight fishing charters, suitable for families, groups, and serious anglers.
